note: SC-9/A1(b) pin for malformed_entries. An entry with no usable path is not assessable against any policy, so it is counted as a FACT and fails (SC-8/A9's rule) rather than being silently skipped -- silently skipping is how a plan could smuggle unassessable entries past the gate while the count still read clean. Reverting the malformed_entries term alone flips this fixture from fail to pass. Also pins that a null entry does not throw.
